steps.name: Unruly Child
steps.text: When are you going to be finished, mister?

steps.name: Quiet Weiqi Player
steps.text: No rush, let me think a little longer.

steps.name: Unruly Child
steps.text: But you've been thinking for half a day now. Last time I came by, you were thinking, and the time before that too. Were you tricked by someone?

steps.name: Unruly Child
steps.text: I've been here lots of times now, and I've never actually seen anyone play weiqi with you.

steps.name: Quiet Weiqi Player
steps.text: You're not wrong. I'm just... thinking about how I should proceed.

steps.name: Quiet Weiqi Player
steps.text: You need to consider how your opponent will react after you place a stone, and all the changes that will arise after.

steps.name: Unruly Child
steps.text: Sounds like a pain. Just thinking about it makes my head hurt... Can't you finish this game first, then ask the one you're playing with to teach you later?

steps.name: Unruly Child
steps.text: It's just weiqi, nothing's going to happen if you lose.

steps.name: Quiet Weiqi Player
steps.text: But I cannot lose.

steps.name: Quiet Weiqi Player
steps.text: The one who arranged this game promised me that, if I win, he shall grant me a wish.

steps.name: Unruly Child
steps.text: A wish? Really?

steps.name: Unruly Child
steps.text: *sigh* Shame I don't get any of this strategic thinking. I think I'm more suited for physical stuff...

steps.name: Unruly Child
steps.text: The sun's about to set, so I should get home. There's still a pile of junk I need to sort out.

steps.name: Unruly Child
steps.text: Zaijian!

steps.name: Unruly Child
steps.text: Oh, right, I just thought of something. We've seen each other lots of times now, but I still don't know your name, mister.

steps.name: Quiet Weiqi Player
steps.text: My surname is Lan, while my name is Ke. 'Lan' of the orchid flower, and 'Ke' of possibility.

steps.name: Unruly Child
steps.text: You do remember my name, right, mister?

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: Luo Qin?

steps.name: Little Luo
steps.text: That's right!

steps.name: Little Luo
steps.text: I really gotta go now. Mother said we need to move out of the house for a bit. When I'm back, I'll definitely come to see you again.

steps.name: Little Luo
steps.text: Zaijian!
The sound of the boy's footsteps slowly fades away. Night falls upon the weiqi board. Sunlight falls upon the stones. Rain and snow wash the stone benches.
Lan Ke picks up a white stone. He nearly places it down, but retracts his hand. Half a day later, he finally throws the stone back into its bowl.
His tenth dead end. He keeps it clear in his memory.
Time for yet another round of calculation. This time, he must come up with some wondrous move or the other to triumph.

steps.name: Courteous Gentleman
steps.text: We have arrived, Mr. Yun.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Did you not say earlier that the one who awaited me was atop the mountain?

steps.name: Courteous Gentleman
steps.text: 'Tis true, 'tis true. That person is atop the mountain, indeed, but my duty is merely to show you the path leading up to it.

steps.name: Courteous Gentleman
steps.text: There is only one path going up the mountain, but it is not hard to walk. The forest around it has been cleared, so you should not run into any wild beasts.

steps.name: Courteous Gentleman
steps.text: You need only head up. The rest has been arranged for you.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: I suppose it would be rude if I inquire too deeply...

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Then let us say our goodbyes here.

steps.name: Courteous Gentleman
steps.text: May we meet again, Mr. Yun.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: You say that, but...

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: I don't think I actually see a path up the mountain here...

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: The ground is completely covered in leaves. I doubt anyone has come this way in a very long time.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Not even signs of any beast trails...

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Perhaps I should find a local to ask for help.

steps.name: Hesitant Girl
steps.text: Good day?

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Good day, my lady. Is something the matter?

steps.name: Hesitant Girl
steps.text: May I ask if you have seen my husband?

steps.name: Hesitant Girl
steps.text: He is young, with hair of brown and a tail point of pure white. He is wearing a cloud-white tunic, trousers the color of earth, and leather boots.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: I... don't think I've seen anyone who matches that description. My apologies.

steps.name: Hesitant Girl
steps.text: Is that so? Pardon me for wasting your time.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Hold on, madam!

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Do you happen to be from these parts? I wanted to ask if there was a path up the mountain nearby.

steps.name: Hesitant Girl
steps.text: You wish to ascend? Then I fear you've gone the wrong way.

steps.name: Hesitant Girl
steps.text: The regular path up the mountain is on the other side of town. This is the back of the mountain, which is rugged and steep. The townsfolk rarely ever come this way.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: (The back of the mountain? I distinctly remember coming straight from the town's main road. How did I end up on the back?)

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: I see now. Duoxie, madam.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: But I believe... since the gentleman guiding me told me specifically to come this way, he must have considered all this. I will continue trying.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Please, excuse me.

steps.name: Hesitant Girl
steps.text: I shall accompany you up the mount, sir.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: I'm sure there's no need—

steps.name: Hesitant Girl
steps.text: The road up the mountain is dangerous. If we are together, we can look out for each other.

steps.name: Hesitant Girl
steps.text: Besides, I have already made inquiries everywhere I could in town. The mountain is the last place I have yet to search. If my husband is still in the area, the only place he can be is here.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Then, I shall have to thank you again.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: May I ask how I should call you?

steps.name: Hesitant Girl
steps.text: ...Bai Jin.

steps.name: Luo Qin
steps.text: Still stuck on that board, Brother Lan?

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: I'm hardly in a hurry.

steps.name: Luo Qin
steps.text: You've been at it for so long, I've learned how to play myself.

steps.name: Luo Qin
steps.text: This situation on the board, isn't it a 'three jie cycle'? They call it a 'triple ko' in Higashi. Shouldn't it be a draw according to the rules?

spans.text: This situation on the board, isn't it a 'three
jie
cycle'? They call it a 'triple
ko
' in Higashi. Shouldn't it be a draw according to the rules?

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: A draw... A draw is unacceptable.

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: The rules were very clear. Only through a win will he grant my wish...

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: No, I need to find a way to victory...

steps.name: Luo Qin
steps.text: What's this wish you want so bad that you need to win this game? Isn't there another way you can make it happen?

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: Another way... What other way...?

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: There is no other way for two as separate as yin and yang to meet again...

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: O miserable fate... From where do you flow?

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: Will this do, Jin'er?

steps.name: Bai Jin
steps.text: It's beautiful! You really are skilled, my dear.

steps.name: Bai Jin
steps.text: And here I was, thinking your ability to bake porcelain only applied to weiqi pieces.

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: Heheh, I can do a lot more than that. Next time, whatever you fancy, whatever you like, I'll be happy to bake it for you.

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: Once we are wed, I'll put this vase in the most conspicuous spot in the living room.

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: 'Vase in the east, mirror in the west, enjoy lifelong tranquility and rest'... We're still missing a mirror, then. But if we place one, we won't have anywhere for the clock. Well, the bell in town rings in the morning and the night, it'll do.

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: In time, there shall be flowers in the vase, and you in the mirror's shine.

steps.name: Bai Jin
steps.text: Oh, that's enough out of you. We don't have much fuel left, so head out to the back of the mountain to chop a few logs while it's still light out.

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: Alright, just sit tight, then. I'll be right back.

steps.name: Bai Jin
steps.text: I will. Dinner should be about ready when you get back.

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: What the... What's going on...?

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: Where did these monsters come from?!

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: Jin'er———!

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: So there was... a path here... all along.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Do you... need a hand... Madam Bai?

steps.name: Bai Jin
steps.text: You do not need to concern yourself about me, Mr. Yun.

steps.name: Bai Jin
steps.text: I grew up amongst the mounts and fields. This is but a leisurely stroll to me.

steps.name: Bai Jin
steps.text: You, on the other hand, look rather pale. Would you like to rest a moment?

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: I shall... take you up... on your offer.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Hoo... Hah...

steps.name: Bai Jin
steps.text: Your dedication is much like my husband's.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: He sounds like a very conscientious man.

steps.name: Bai Jin
steps.text: He is.

steps.name: Bai Jin
steps.text: He approaches everything with absolute focus. It is rare for anyone's urgings to have any effect.

steps.name: Bai Jin
steps.text: He will stay in one place without food, water or moving until he is done. *sigh* He really does inspire both pity and frustration.

steps.name: Bai Jin
steps.text: At least he listens when I speak, so it's always me who has to pull him away by the ear. That's how it's always been since we were little.

spans.text: At least he listens when
I
speak, so it's always me who has to pull him away by the ear. That's how it's always been since we were little.

steps.name: Bai Jin
steps.text: But there was a gentleman who played weiqi in town who said this temperament was suited for the game.

steps.name: Bai Jin
steps.text: With a few years of study, he could become a master, perhaps even a grandmaster. If he does, he can leave town and head off to distant lands to look around.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Your husband left to study weiqi?

steps.name: Bai Jin
steps.text: Yes. He has been studying for a very long time now.

steps.name: Bai Jin
steps.text: He throws his all into his studies and barely listens to what anyone has to say. It's simply too much, I tell you.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Haha... I have also heard about the endless marvels of black against white upon the gridded board, and how captivating they can be.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: The land is vast, and there are many things that can trap a man in a mire. Even a memory can leave one pacing back and forth for quite some time.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Your husband must have his reasons for his dedication.

steps.name: Bai Jin
steps.text: Why exactly are you trying to argue his case?

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: I was simply moved by his tale.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Well... You said your husband disappeared, but when exactly was this disappearance?

steps.name: Bai Jin
steps.text: He...

steps.name: Bai Jin
steps.text: It was nearly nightfall, and he went out to the mountain to chop some firewood. I never heard from him after that.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: That truly is worrying.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Let us set off then, Madam Bai.

steps.name: Bai Jin
steps.text: Do you not wish to sit a little longer? Pardon me for saying so, but your body does not seem the strongest, nor do you look accustomed to steep mountain paths.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: While I might not be able to perform martial arts, I practice breathing techniques every day.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: The path is yet long, so I must be diligent.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: I see an ancient pavilion further up. We can rest again once we arrive there.

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: The game's still stuck in a stalemate, huh... He's been thinking about his next move for ages now...

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: Just how long have you been working on this one move, Brother Lan?

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: I don't know.

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: My grandson's now as tall as I was back then.

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: He didn't believe me at all when I told him about you. 'Who would spend their entire life on a single lousy game?', he said.

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: Do you still remember when exactly you got separated from Sister Bai?

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: I don't.

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: After I left town, I got lost and was disheartened. I wandered the mountain for several months before arriving here. It can't have been that long.

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: And what day was that?

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: There are some things I don't remember all that clearly.

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: Then do you know today's date?

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: But that's not important. Let us speak of other things once I solve this deadlock.

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: Oh, everyone in town's been so in a tizzy over some treasure or the other that I never expected someone to come over here.

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: Here to see the game as well, youngster?

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: We're just here to take a rest—

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: 'We'? But it's just you.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Just me? The lady I was climbing the mountain with...

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Strange... She was here just a moment ago...
Yun Qingping looks all around him, but there is no sight of the woman.
There is only a young man, sitting at a weiqi board in silence.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: And this gentleman is...?

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: *sigh* He's trapped in that game. There's no getting him out of it.

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: If you know how to play, help him out a bit.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: This game state...

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: A three jie cycle. A prolonged battle that can only end in a draw.

spans.text: A three
jie
cycle. A prolonged battle that can only end in a draw.

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: But he's dead set on victory, so in the end, he trapped himself here.

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: I can't think of a way to get him out...

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: (Observes the board)

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: (Contemplates)

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: H-Heaven above, it's trapped another.

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: One after another, *sigh*...

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: A refusal to draw, victory the only satisfactory option...

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: If one focuses only on the jie, can one truly demonstrate superiority on the battlefield?

spans.text: If one focuses only on the
jie
, can one truly demonstrate superiority on the battlefield?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: This boy... He yet lives.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: But with such grievous wounds, he will have to endure many hardships.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: I can't practice kung fu with this body of mine, so what use is there in me recording all the many styles under Heaven?

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: I don't understand, Grandmaster...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Yun, have you ever questioned the Grandmaster's plans for you?

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Of course I have. When I first took this job, my heart still harbored some resentment. I felt like making me watch everyone practice kung fu every day was like chaining me atop a stake while dangling meat before my eyes.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: The scent hits you like a fist, your eyes go wide with greed, but you can never have even half a bite. I tormented myself with an endless barrage of complaints as I suffered in discontent.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You don't look like you're suffering now.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Even though my progress is only theoretical, it is enough to soothe me.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: But more importantly, I believe I understand some of the reasoning behind it.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Have I told you about my recent dreams, Zuo?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: No, might as well tell me now.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: One night, I dreamed that I would return to the countryside someday, a nameless, obscure man. All those many martial moves and techniques, when used upon the fields, will let you save a considerable amount of strength in tilling and hoeing the land.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Another night, I was a passionate warrior, quick to kindness and vengeance, an imitator of the Grandmaster. Strike, and sunder the tides cleft. Retract, and leave no peace bereft. A legend born from a single punch, before dying after all my breath is spent.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: They both sound really different from the Yun I know...

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Obsession is a quagmire. It is natural for those trapped within to not understand.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: After much deliberation, there is but only one answer...

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: First give, then observe, and finally, take.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: The stone should go here.
Yun Qingping picks up a white stone, paying no heed to the massive hundred-point battle raging on the board as he nonchalantly places it on the other side of the board.
Black takes the opportunity to wipe out the majority of white stones atop the board, but then comes a stunning reversal, leaving white with a clear advantage.
Lan Ke watches in stunned silence as the countless stones, both black and white, disappear as if they were but mirages. All that is left is a clear board, and three men surrounding it.
The stalemate has been broken.

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: My word... To think there was a move like that!

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: Duoxie, my friend, duoxie! I couldn't come up with anything despite thinking for so long. I never expected you to break it open the moment you arrived. You have my admiration!

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: You flatter me. I don't actually know much about weiqi. I simply thought that, since all things on this land are connected, martial doctrines that espouse give and take could be applied to weiqi as well. I didn't think it would work out so well.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Your weiqi skills far exceed mine, but since you were so focused on winning the jie cycle, you overlooked the overall state of the board.

spans.text: Your weiqi skills far exceed mine, but since you were so focused on winning the
jie
cycle, you overlooked the overall state of the board.

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: No matter how you put it, this game is won!

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: Is that you... Luo Qin?

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: I'm Luo Qin's grandson.

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: When he was still alive, he'd always talk about the strange man back home playing weiqi atop the mountain. I've visited you many times, thinking I'd have to pass this task on to my own grandson. Didn't think this man'd put a stop to it all, youngster.

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: That means I've spent...

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: Over a hundred years here. The town's changed too.

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: So I've been... separated from Jin'er... for all these years...
My dear.

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: Jin'er?!

steps.name: Bai Jin
steps.text: Yes, it's me.

steps.name: Bai Jin
steps.text: Long time no see... dear.

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: It's really you! That Xian wasn't lying to me! I really did meet you again!

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: Amazing... Truly incredible...

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: Let's go home right away! Mom and Dad are still waiting for us—

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: Jin'er...? Why won't you... say anything...?

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: I see... Hahaha.... So that's how it is...

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: I was already... long ago...

steps.name: Lan Ke
steps.text: But it doesn't matter. I got to... see you again...
With the game ended, the Xian keeps his promise.
And so, Lan Ke is free of his regrets.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Madam Bai...

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: No, you are not the Madam Bai of this tale.

steps.name: 'Bai Jin'
steps.text: Yes. After seeing my love, what more have I to pine for?

steps.name: 'Bai Jin'
steps.text: I was but a stack of joss papers before her cenotaph, soaked in his tears and longing.

steps.name: 'Bai Jin'
steps.text: Her desires, my destiny, were bound together in this meeting with him.

steps.name: 'Bai Jin'
steps.text: With him gone, there is no reason for me to stay here.

steps.name: 'Bai Jin'
steps.text: I beg the two of you, fulfill my final request. Place my love's grave by her cenotaph, then burn 'me' as an offering.

steps.name: 'Bai Jin'
steps.text: We may not have been able to grow old together in this life, but I hope that in the next... we will meet again...
'Madam Bai' falls silent, then bows deeply. And in an instant—
There is only a stack of joss papers, fluttering in the wind.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Joss paper... So this particular Bai Jin was a geist?

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: A hundred and twenty years ago, for reasons unknown, a horde of geists fell upon the town one night, wantonly lashing out at anyone and everyone. Truly a calamity.

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: My granddad was saved by the young man named Lan Ke.

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: He helped many townspeople escape with their lives that night... but he himself had to be saved from the flood of geists by Bai Jin.

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: As for her... She died that night.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Mr. Lan and Madam Bai were kind people...

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: I heard those geists are born from thoughts. Once those obsessions are gone, they go back to being regular objects.

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: The secret passed down my family for three generations has finally borne fruit, so why do my tears refuse to stop...

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: I'm heading down the mountain, youngster. I need to make sure Sister Bai's request gets done, and also tell my granddad about what happened.

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: How about you?

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: There's someone I'm meeting on the mountain. I need to get going.

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: This mountain's so lively nowadays. No idea what kind of bigshot asked you to climb up the back side to meet up.

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: Well, I'll be off then.

steps.name: Old Luo
steps.text: If, by any chance, we meet again, you're welcome at mine for a cup of tea.
Old Luo carefully packs up the things on the ground, putting them in his basket before tottering down the mountain.
Was it you who broke the stalemate?

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: May I inquire as to who is speaking?
A half-life who deals with menial tasks, a hard-working geist is all.
You are Da—Chongyue's record-keeping man, the one by his side.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: I presume you are one of the Sui proxies, then.
Forgive me for inviting you in such a matter. Let us ascend. There is a guest at the peak awaiting you.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: So I was 'invited'...?
Indeed. At first, it was for other matters... but who could have expected you to chance upon that game and break the deadlock with a flick of your wrist?
(Loudly) You were right again! You happy, you weiqi failure?!

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: It was pure happenstance. Did someone really predict that would happen?
When the second brother left this board here, he proclaimed that only a man with true intelligence could resolve it.
Now that I think about it, him arranging this board here... The closest to 'human' of us siblings is the eldest brother, and calling one of his disciples over... Hardly an odd move.
Let us climb.
Remember to take the board with you. The game is over, so it's yours now.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Very well...

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: I do not know what to call you.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Just the one character, Liang, 'Liang' of the roof beam.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Mr. Liang, you said that only the Grandmaster's students could break this deadlock just now, but the game already had a player before I came here.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: You mean that Lan Ke?

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: He really did make a promise at the time, which kept Lan Ke playing.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: It was a game where the more obsessed you were with the jie, the less able you were to resolve it. He knew full well that a weiqi player would be mesmerized by them, yet still allowed him to join...

spans.text: It was a game where the more obsessed you were with the
jie
, the less able you were to resolve it. He knew full well that a weiqi player would be mesmerized by them, yet still allowed him to join...

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: It could be said that the one who arranged this game simply wished to play, or perhaps...

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: The one who uses weiqi as a means to meet, has a heart as stubborn as this eternal deadlock?

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Ah, a fine way of looking at it. Yes, very fine indeed.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: (Barely-controlled vibrating)

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Please, go ahead and tell it to his face next time.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: We have arrived.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: This is the one who wished to meet you.

steps.name: Clever Girl
steps.text: I suppose it is fate that determined we should meet again.

steps.name: Clever Girl
steps.text: It is a pleasure to see you again, Mr. Yun.
